tinker.name: Base64
tinker.description: Base64 encoder/decoder for text and files

zh-CN.name: Base64
zh-CN.description: Base64 编解码，支持文本和文件

encode.description: Encode text or a file to Base64. Provide exactly one of text or path. Updates the plugin UI and returns the Base64 output.

text.description: Text content to encode. Mutually exclusive with path.

path.description: Absolute path to a file to encode. Mutually exclusive with text.

asDataUrl.description: When encoding a file, return a data URL (data:<mime>;base64,...). Defaults to the current UI setting. Ignored for text.

decode.description: Decode Base64 text to UTF-8 text, or write decoded bytes to a file when path is provided. Updates the plugin UI. Accepts raw Base64 or a data URL.

text.description: Base64 string or data URL to decode

path.description: Absolute path to write decoded bytes. When omitted, decode to UTF-8 text in the UI.
